The main takeaway from our work is that
cricohyroidoepiglottsopexy (CHEP) is an effective treatment for glottic and supraglottic stenosis.

cricohyroidopexy (CHP) is an effective treatment modality for patients who have had transoral laser surgery or chemoradiation (CRT) for early stage glottic cancer and who have developed post-treatment glottic insufficiency.
CHP should be considered as a treatment option for patients with severe aspiration and dysphonia.
